pages.text: Ars Nouveau is the primary $(t2)Tier 2$() magic mod. Customizable spell glyphs, familiars, and magical automation.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Ars Nouveau is the $(thing)Battlemage$() and $(thing)Archmage$()'s natural home at $(t2)Tier 2$(). The glyph-based spell system allows building custom spells tailored to your class's strengths.$(br2)$(bold)Source generation:$() Ars Nouveau uses Source as its resource. Source Jars and Sourcelinks are the $(t2)T2$() mana automation backbone.

$(bold)Faefolk synergy:$() +10% spell power from the Nature Magic racial. Ars Nouveau's nature-flavored spells benefit the most.$(br2)$(bold)What unlocks at T2:$() Full spellbook access, Bookwyrm familiar, Drygmy for mob farming, Whirlisprig for crop automation. These become available once you have $(t2)T2$() stage.
Craft the $(bold)Worn Notebook$() for the full Ars Nouveau reference — every glyph, every augment, familiar guides, and automation setups.
